stat.title: Sites
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(s.id) as cnt from Site as s left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id left outer join State as st on g.stateId = st.id left outer join Lga as l on g.lgaId = l.id

stat.title: Devices
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(d.id) as cnt from Device as d inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join DeviceType as dt on dt.id = d.deviceTypeId inner join DeviceTypeCategory as dc on dc.id = dt.deviceTypeCategoryId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where dc.hasResults = 1
stat.description: The number of devices which type's category allows results

stat.title: Results
stat.subTitle: Last 30 Days
stat.sqlForIndicator: select ifnull(sum(f.resultCount), 0) as cnt from FactResultsDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on p.id = s.partnerId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where f.days = 30
stat.description: The number of results for the last 30 days

stat.title: Contacts
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(u.id) as cnt from User as u
